title: P2 principal: request
description: Add a principal with an identity, disable, restore, change the identity. People without privileged groups are managed by an admin with admin:people; people with privileged groups, external programs and system only by the operator through farmctl (operator_only). Disabling cancels, in the same transaction, the pending approvals and decisions where the principal is the initiator (APR-6).

kind.description: Principal kind: a person, an external program or the service principal system (IDN-1).

identity.description: Identity in the channel: telegram:<id>, api:<key_id>, hook:<source> or email:<address> (IDN-1).
